2.  **Wheels:**
    *   Next, we will use the `cylinder` function to create the four wheels.
    *   All four wheels will have a radius of 25 and a thickness (height) of 10. They will be added to the existing geometry.
    *   To ensure the wheels are on the ground (Z=0 plane), their centers will be at a Z-coordinate of 25 (equal to their radius).
    *   The two left-side wheels will be placed at X-coordinates 25 and 175, on the Y=0 side of the body. They will extend outwards in the negative Y-direction.
    *   The two right-side wheels will be placed at the same X-coordinates but on the Y=100 side of the body, extending outwards in the positive Y-direction.

This process will accurately construct the toy car model as you've described.
